MTS-ESP client library by ODDSound (https://github.com/ODDSound/MTS-ESP), folder Client/,
licence: 0BSD (see LICENSE). Unchanged. Commit see VERSION.txt.

The client looks for the MTS-ESP library (LIBMTS.dll / libMTS.dylib / libMTS.so) at run time;
it is installed together with an MTS-ESP master (e.g. the free "MTS-ESP Mini" by ODDSound).
Without it the plugin works as before; MIDI Tuning Standard SysEx is still understood.
